BL-1505 — test_handoffd_wake_attribution_wiring.sh case 05 has been red on main since 2026-08-27 with no owner, and it is detecting a live defect: since the wake dedup landed (cbe63cceba) a chase whose wake text is withheld as unchanged-mailbox returns false from the wake adapter, chase_sweep_lib writes the chase sidecar and logs the chase only on true, so a parcel in an unchanged inbox is woken once and never counted again - chaseCount stays 0 and the respawn and dead-letter rungs are unreachable for a live pane that ignores its wake; a chase attempt counts whether or not its text was injected
